jp: \t\t実際に噴火の現場で描かれたという、違う意味で伝説の一品の版画。この世の終わりのような光景から、むせかえるほどの熱気と凄まじさが伝わってくる。\n#～イムウエル交易譚～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t実際に噴火の現場で描かれたという、違う意味で伝説の一品の版画。この世の終わりのような光景から、むせかえるほどの熱気と凄まじさが伝わってくる。\n#～イムウエル交易譚～\n"
en: In some parts of Gaius Vis, a rabbit's foot, not its tail, is a lucky charm. It has been handed down since ancient times and is a popular travel companion among adventurers. \n# ~the Aimwell tale of trade~
en_grezzo: "In some parts of Gaius Vis, a rabbit's foot, not its tail, is a lucky charm. It has been handed down since ancient times and is a popular travel companion among adventurers. \n# ~the Aimwell tale of trade~"
it: Una stampa che dicono disegnata sul posto, durante l'eruzione: un pezzo leggendario, ma in un altro senso. Da quella scena, che pare la fine del mondo, arrivano un calore soffocante e tutto il suo furore. \n# ~Racconti di Commercio di Aimwell~

jp: \t\tガイアス・ヴィスの一部地域では、ウサギの尻尾ではなく足が幸運のお守り。古くから伝わり、冒険者のあいだでも旅のお供として人気がある。\n#～イムウエル交易譚～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tガイアス・ヴィスの一部地域では、ウサギの尻尾ではなく足が幸運のお守り。古くから伝わり、冒険者のあいだでも旅のお供として人気がある。\n#～イムウエル交易譚～\n"
en: In some parts of Gaius Vis, a rabbit's foot, not its tail, is a lucky charm. It has been handed down since ancient times and is a popular travel companion among adventurers. \n# ~the Aimwell tale of trade~
en_grezzo: "In some parts of Gaius Vis, a rabbit's foot, not its tail, is a lucky charm. It has been handed down since ancient times and is a popular travel companion among adventurers. \n# ~the Aimwell tale of trade~"
it: In certe zone di Gaius Vis il portafortuna è la zampa del coniglio, non la coda. Si tramanda da tempi antichi, e fra gli avventurieri va per la maggiore come compagna di viaggio. \n# ~Racconti di Commercio di Aimwell~

jp: \t\tサウスティリスの湖に生育するマリモをちぎって人工的に丸めたもの。これを作るために大量採取していることで湖のマリモは絶滅の危機を迎えている。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tサウスティリスの湖に生育するマリモをちぎって人工的に丸めたもの。これを作るために大量採取していることで湖のマリモは絶滅の危機を迎えている。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n"
en: Marimo that grows in a lake in South Tyris, is ripped off and artificially rounded up. The lake's marimo is in danger of extinction due to the mass harvesting. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~
en_grezzo: "Marimo that grows in a lake in South Tyris, is ripped off and artificially rounded up. The lake's marimo is in danger of extinction due to the mass harvesting. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~"
it: Marimo che cresce nel lago di Tyris del Sud, strappato e poi arrotondato a mano. Per fabbricarlo se ne raccoglie tanto che il marimo del lago rischia l'estinzione. \n# ~Il Commercio Vincente Secondo gli Eulderna~

jp: \t\tイェルス軍が観賞用グッズとして民間に払い下げした古い軍用レーション。食品としてはとっくに駄目になっている。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tイェルス軍が観賞用グッズとして民間に払い下げした古い軍用レーション。食品としてはとっくに駄目になっている。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n"
en: Old military ration that was dispensed to the civilian by the Yerles Army as an ornamental item. Long since ruined as food. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~
en_grezzo: "Old military ration that was dispensed to the civilian by the Yerles Army as an ornamental item. Long since ruined as food. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~"
it: Una vecchia razione militare che l'esercito di Yerles ha ceduto ai civili come soprammobile. Come cibo è andata a male da un pezzo. \n# ~Il Commercio Vincente Secondo gli Eulderna~

jp: \t\t一通りの絵画用具が詰まった交易品。開封すると絵具などが周囲に散らばってしまう為、使用することはできない。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t一通りの絵画用具が詰まった交易品。開封すると絵具などが周囲に散らばってしまう為、使用することはできない。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n"
en: Trade goods filled with a set of painting tools. It cannot be used because paints and other materials will be scattered around when the package is opened. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~
en_grezzo: "Trade goods filled with a set of painting tools. It cannot be used because paints and other materials will be scattered around when the package is opened. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~"
it: Una merce da commercio con dentro tutto l'occorrente per dipingere. Non si può usare: ad aprirla, i colori e il resto finiscono sparsi dappertutto. \n# ~Il Commercio Vincente Secondo gli Eulderna~

jp: \t\t様々な芸術家が書いた絵を一絡げにした交易品。そうは言っても最低限の保管はされている為、取引先で開いたらまるで価値のないものになっていた、といったトラブルは起こっていないようだ。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t様々な芸術家が書いた絵を一絡げにした交易品。そうは言っても最低限の保管はされている為、取引先で開いたらまるで価値のないものになっていた、といったトラブルは起こっていないようだ。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n"
en: The trade goods are a collection of paintings by various artists. Even so, they are kept in a minimum amount of storage, so there seems to be no trouble such as opening them at a trading partner and finding that they are worthless. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~
en_grezzo: "The trade goods are a collection of paintings by various artists. Even so, they are kept in a minimum amount of storage, so there seems to be no trouble such as opening them at a trading partner and finding that they are worthless. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~"
it: Una merce da commercio che mette insieme alla rinfusa quadri di artisti diversi. Detto questo, il minimo della conservazione c'è, e non risulta che qualcuno l'abbia aperta davanti al compratore trovandoci dentro roba senza alcun valore. \n# ~Il Commercio Vincente Secondo gli Eulderna~

jp: \t\t雪で作られた可愛らしい交易品。そのとぼけた表情に癒しを感じ、購入していくものが多いという。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t雪で作られた可愛らしい交易品。そのとぼけた表情に癒しを感じ、購入していくものが多いという。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n"
en: Cute trading goods made of snow. Many of them feel comforted by their bland expressions and purchase them. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~
en_grezzo: "Cute trading goods made of snow. Many of them feel comforted by their bland expressions and purchase them. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~"
it: Una graziosa merce da commercio fatta di neve. Quell'aria svagata consola, e pare che in molti la comprino per questo. \n# ~Il Commercio Vincente Secondo gli Eulderna~

jp: \t\t伐採したモミの木に幾多の飾りをつけたとても重い交易品。ノイエルまで足を運べない人が自宅でお祝いをする為に買っていくという。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t伐採したモミの木に幾多の飾りをつけたとても重い交易品。ノイエルまで足を運べない人が自宅でお祝いをする為に買っていくという。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n"
en: Very heavy traded goods made of felled fir trees decorated with many ornaments. It is said that people who cannot travel to Noyel buy it to celebrate at home. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~
en_grezzo: "Very heavy traded goods made of felled fir trees decorated with many ornaments. It is said that people who cannot travel to Noyel buy it to celebrate at home. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~"
it: Una merce da commercio molto pesante: un abete abbattuto e carico di addobbi. La comprano, dicono, quelli che a Noyel non ci possono arrivare e vogliono festeggiare a casa loro. \n# ~Il Commercio Vincente Secondo gli Eulderna~

jp: \t\t浮き輪を幾つかのまとまりで束ねた交易品。捌きにくくなる為、ばら売りはできない。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t浮き輪を幾つかのまとまりで束ねた交易品。捌きにくくなる為、ばら売りはできない。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n"
en: A trade item consisting of several bundles of lifebuoy. They cannot be sold separately because they are difficult to sell. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~
en_grezzo: "A trade item consisting of several bundles of lifebuoy. They cannot be sold separately because they are difficult to sell. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~"
it: Una merce da commercio fatta di salvagenti legati in più mazzi. Sciolti diventano difficili da smerciare, e infatti non si vendono a uno a uno. \n# ~Il Commercio Vincente Secondo gli Eulderna~

jp: \t\t複雑な機巧を備えた、見るものを楽しませる交易品。重たいので取り扱いには注意が必要だ。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t複雑な機巧を備えた、見るものを楽しませる交易品。重たいので取り扱いには注意が必要だ。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n"
en: An intricately crafted trading item that is a joy to behold. It is heavy and should be handled with care. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~
en_grezzo: "An intricately crafted trading item that is a joy to behold. It is heavy and should be handled with care. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~"
it: Una merce da commercio con dentro un congegno complicato, che diverte chi la guarda. È pesante, e a maneggiarla ci vuole attenzione. \n# ~Il Commercio Vincente Secondo gli Eulderna~

jp: \t\t貰うと嬉しい交易品。開封すると価値が大幅に落ちる為、使用することはできない。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t貰うと嬉しい交易品。開封すると価値が大幅に落ちる為、使用することはできない。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n"
en: A trading item that is nice to receive. It cannot be used because its value drops dramatically once it is opened. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~
en_grezzo: "A trading item that is nice to receive. It cannot be used because its value drops dramatically once it is opened. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~"
it: Una merce da commercio che fa piacere ricevere. Non si può usare: ad aprirla, il valore crolla. \n# ~Il Commercio Vincente Secondo gli Eulderna~

jp: \t\t個人で食すには余りにも巨大なツナ。主に交易品として取引される。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t個人で食すには余りにも巨大なツナ。主に交易品として取引される。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n"
en: Tuna is too huge to be eaten by individuals. It is mainly traded as a commodity. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~
en_grezzo: "Tuna is too huge to be eaten by individuals. It is mainly traded as a commodity. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~"
it: Un tonno decisamente troppo grosso perché una persona sola se lo mangi. Si tratta soprattutto come merce da commercio. \n# ~Il Commercio Vincente Secondo gli Eulderna~

jp: \t\t石で造られたとても重い交易品。無茶をして墓運びが墓に埋もれる、等ということにならないように。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t石で造られたとても重い交易品。無茶をして墓運びが墓に埋もれる、等ということにならないように。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n"
en: Very heavy trading goods made of stone. Do not be reckless and let the grave carrier be buried in the grave. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~
en_grezzo: "Very heavy trading goods made of stone. Do not be reckless and let the grave carrier be buried in the grave. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~"
it: Una merce da commercio di pietra, molto pesante. Meglio non strafare: non sia mai che chi porta la tomba finisca sepolto sotto la tomba. \n# ~Il Commercio Vincente Secondo gli Eulderna~

jp: \t\t個人で食すには余りにも巨大なマンボー。主に交易品として取引される。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t個人で食すには余りにも巨大なマンボー。主に交易品として取引される。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n"
en: Mamboos that are too huge to be eaten by individuals. It is mainly traded as a commodity. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~
en_grezzo: "Mamboos that are too huge to be eaten by individuals. It is mainly traded as a commodity. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~"
it: Un pesce luna decisamente troppo grosso perché una persona sola se lo mangi. Si tratta soprattutto come merce da commercio. \n# ~Il Commercio Vincente Secondo gli Eulderna~

jp: \t\t質の高い木材を使った、丁寧な作りの交易品。先約がいるので、使用することはできない。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t質の高い木材を使った、丁寧な作りの交易品。先約がいるので、使用することはできない。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n"
en: A carefully crafted trade item made of high quality wood. It is not available for use because of prior commitments. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~
en_grezzo: "A carefully crafted trade item made of high quality wood. It is not available for use because of prior commitments. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~"
it: Una merce da commercio fatta con cura, in legno di qualità. Non si può usare: c'è già chi l'ha prenotata. \n# ~Il Commercio Vincente Secondo gli Eulderna~

jp: \t\tきつく束ねられた交易品。解れたら大変なので、使用することはできない。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tきつく束ねられた交易品。解れたら大変なので、使用することはできない。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n"
en: Tightly bound trade goods. You cannot use it because it would be very troublesome if it gets loose. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~
en_grezzo: "Tightly bound trade goods. You cannot use it because it would be very troublesome if it gets loose. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~"
it: Una merce da commercio legata stretta. Non si può usare: se si scioglie, sono guai. \n# ~Il Commercio Vincente Secondo gli Eulderna~

jp: \t\t色鮮やかなとても重い交易品。音は出るが所詮観賞用に作られた代物なので、まともに使用することはできない。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t色鮮やかなとても重い交易品。音は出るが所詮観賞用に作られた代物なので、まともに使用することはできない。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n"
en: A brightly colored, very heavy trade item. Although it produces sound, it cannot be used properly because it was only made for ornamental purposes. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~
en_grezzo: "A brightly colored, very heavy trade item. Although it produces sound, it cannot be used properly because it was only made for ornamental purposes. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~"
it: Una merce da commercio dai colori vivaci, molto pesante. Il suono lo fa, ma in fondo è roba costruita per far scena, e a usarla sul serio non si va da nessuna parte. \n# ~Il Commercio Vincente Secondo gli Eulderna~

jp: \t\tこちらが映りこむほどに磨き上げられた交易品。一つ一つが手作りの豪華仕様となっている。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tこちらが映りこむほどに磨き上げられた交易品。一つ一つが手作りの豪華仕様となっている。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n"
en: The trade goods are so polished that they mirror each other. Each one is handmade to a luxurious specification. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~
en_grezzo: "The trade goods are so polished that they mirror each other. Each one is handmade to a luxurious specification. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~"
it: Una merce da commercio lucidata al punto che ci si vede dentro. Ogni pezzo è fatto a mano, in versione di lusso. \n# ~Il Commercio Vincente Secondo gli Eulderna~

jp: \t\t丁寧に包まれた交易品。開封してしまうと価値が下がる為、使用することはできない。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t丁寧に包まれた交易品。開封してしまうと価値が下がる為、使用することはできない。\n#～エウダーナに学ぶ必勝交易法～\n"
en: Carefully wrapped trade goods. Once opened, it cannot be used because its value will decrease. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~
en_grezzo: "Carefully wrapped trade goods. Once opened, it cannot be used because its value will decrease. \n# ~Eulderna's Winning Strategy for Trading~"
it: Una merce da commercio impacchettata con cura. Non si può usare: ad aprirla, il valore cala. \n# ~Il Commercio Vincente Secondo gli Eulderna~
